title: Kiwi Mate Off
style: Comedy rap with bouncy boom-bap swagger, playful swing, cheeky punch-ins, and a call-and-response groove; verse one sparsely rides kick, snare, and rubbery bass, pre-chorus tightens with claps and rising vocal chants, chorus punches in with gang shouts and sticky repetition. Double-tracked lead with ad-lib panning, quick delay throws on punchlines, and little ear-candy bleeps between bars. Bright, crisp, and cartoon-clean mix., rap
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I roll up in thongs, he rolls up in jandals
Same exact walk, but we fight like vandals
He says “sweet as, bro,” I say “too easy, mate”
He says “yeah, nah,” then he laughs in my face

He brought pavlova, I brought meat pies
He called my accent “cute,” I nearly lost my mind
I said “she’ll be right,” he said “strewth, calm down”
Then we both split chips on the harbour crown

[Pre-Chorus]
Oi, oi, oi, who runs the room?
Bro says “not you,” then he points at the boom
I say “nah, mate,” with a grin and a shrug
We’re just two legends throwing jokes in the mud

[Chorus]
Kiwi mate, Aussie mate
Who’s the loudest? We both great
Kiwi mate, Aussie mate
Same dumb grin, same big debate
Kiwi mate, Aussie mate
One more laugh, then we shake hands
Kiwi mate, Aussie mate
Best two clowns in the whole damn land

[Verse 2]
He’s got a ute with a dent in the side
Mine got sand from the beach in the ride
He says “chur, bro,” I say “bro, chur too”
We argue over whose barbecue’s cooler than who

His uncle knows footy, my cousin knows rugby
We both yell “mad!” when the plate gets scruffy
He says “no worries,” I say “yeah, sweet”
Then we both steal sauce and call that a treat

[Pre-Chorus]
Oi, oi, oi, let the jokes fly
He’s got the grin, I’ve got the reply
He pokes my hat, I poke his slide
Then we both crack up like we planned this ride

[Chorus]
Kiwi mate, Aussie mate
Who’s the loudest? We both great
Kiwi mate, Aussie mate
Same dumb grin, same big debate
Kiwi mate, Aussie mate
One more laugh, then we shake hands
Kiwi mate, Aussie mate
Best two clowns in the whole damn land

[Bridge]
He says “bro,” I say “mate”
He says “chur,” I say “sweet”
We talk tough, then share chips
That’s the whole damn trick
He says “you’re cooked,” I say “same”
Then we both yell out his name
Not a fight, just a race
To see who can grin in your face

[Chorus]
Kiwi mate, Aussie mate
Who’s the loudest? We both great
Kiwi mate, Aussie mate
Same dumb grin, same big debate
Kiwi mate, Aussie mate
One more laugh, then we shake hands
Kiwi mate, Aussie mate
Best two clowns in the whole damn land
